text:
QUOTE: "a Doxyfile does not decide the file set." and "says the Doxyfile supplies aliases and predefines but not INPUT."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the Doxyfile doesn't decide the file set and doesn't supply INPUT, but never explains why: it omits the point that using it would give a repo that ships one only its documented subset and a repo that ships none its whole tree.
